blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The 18 “maleta boys” who implicated various government officials, including President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., in an alleged “cash delivery” scheme were also asked to undergo lie detector tests when they appeared before the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) in March as part of the investigation into their joint affidavit, NBI Director Melvin Matibag said. This came after Matibag said former police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. is scheduled to undergo a lie detector test before the bureau on Wednesday or Thursday in connection with the affidavit.
